title: 第2362章 深海魔鲨第2361章 深海
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
浪涛席卷的大海上，楚风立于天空中，背后展开一对青色羽翼，衣襟在周身缭绕的‘天空之风力’中猎猎作响。
他双眸微凝，视线穿透翻涌的波涛，锁定着深海之下那团庞大而压抑的阴影——
一头修为达到十万年的深海魔鲨。
“小心，它要上来了。”
楚风话音未落，海面轰然炸裂，一头体长逾三十丈、通体覆盖着幽蓝鳞甲的巨鲨破水而出，腥风扑面而来，恐怖的魂力威压令周遭海水都为之凝滞。
与此同时，一旁的叶灵鸢也显现出武魂真身，站在烈火灵鸢头顶的她，给人的压迫感已经远超之前围攻三头赤魔獒的时候。
这几天她已经成功凝聚魂核，魂力强度得到质变，整体实力迎来了大幅度提升。
“我来为你掠阵！”
叶灵鸢清喝一声，烈火灵鸢双翼一振，漫天火羽如暴雨般倾泻而下，将深海魔鲨笼罩其中。
楚风背后那对青色羽翼舒展半圆，一根根风力凝成的羽毛如箭矢般射出，但这足以轻易贯穿钢铁的风羽，却在触及魔鲨鳞甲的瞬间被幽蓝魂力弹开，没能造成实际伤害。
与之相似的还有叶灵鸢的一击，同样没能伤到深海魔鲨。
亲自体验了二人这孱弱无力的攻击，深海魔鲨已经知道要如何猎杀这两个猎物了。
无需防御，可以尽情的发起攻势。
‘防护力不错。’
楚风神色不变，左腿骨魂技‘赤魔之炎’骤然爆发。
一团暗红色的火焰自他脚下升腾而起，随着天魔魂力的持续灌注，赤魔之炎以肉眼可见的速度膨胀、蔓延，眨眼间便将懒得闪避的魔鲨半个身躯包裹其中。
那火焰如附骨之疽，死死黏在幽蓝鳞甲上，发出‘滋滋’的腐蚀声，魔鲨发出一声痛极的嘶吼，疯狂扭动身躯，试图甩脱火焰，可火焰却越烧越旺，不止没被海水浇灭，反而连它体内的魂力都被引燃，化作燃料维持着燃烧。
下一刻，楚风身形一晃，两个与他容貌无异、却通体燃烧着赤魔之炎的分身自他体内分裂而出。
分身甫一成型，便一左一右扑向魔鲨。左侧分身以仿若自爆的姿态贴在魔鲨身上，燃起更为炽烈的赤魔之炎。右侧分身则化作一道赤红残影，在魔鲨嘶吼时钻入其口，冲进魔鲨体内，从内部焚烧内脏。
见到这熟悉的暗红火焰，叶灵鸢心中升起一丝惊悸，想到了之前围攻三头赤魔獒的经历。

她可是亲自体验过这种特殊火焰的威力，只要无法及时摆脱，哪怕是封号斗罗也会被活活烧死。
‘好厉害的魂骨技。’
叶灵鸢心中惊叹，不禁有些羡慕。
事情正朝着出乎意料的方向发展。
原本她以为会看到一位30级准魂尊手段尽出，鏖战许久后艰难击杀十万年魂兽，成为魂师历史中的神话。
可是看现在这情况……
只要这头深海魔鲨无法扑灭燃烧大半身子的暗红火焰，这场猎杀的结局便已经注定了。
content_en:
On the sea swept by the waves, Chu Feng stood in the sky, with a pair of cyan wings spread out behind his back, and his clothes were buzzing in the "wind force of the sky" that surrounded him.
His eyes were slightly focused, and his gaze penetrated the surging waves, locking on the huge and oppressive shadow under the deep sea——
A deep-sea demon shark with a cultivation level of 100,000 years.
"Careful, it's coming up."
Before Chu Feng finished speaking, the sea surface exploded, and a giant shark with a body length of more than thirty feet and covered with blue scales broke out of the water. A fishy wind blew in his face, and the terrifying pressure of soul power made the surrounding sea water stagnant.
At the same time, Ye Lingyuan on the side also showed her martial soul's true form. Standing on top of Liehuo Lingyuan's head, she gave people a sense of oppression that was far greater than when she besieged the three-headed red demon mastiff.
In the past few days, she has successfully condensed her soul core, her soul power intensity has undergone a qualitative change, and her overall strength has been greatly improved.
"I'll raid the formation for you!"
Ye Lingyuan shouted loudly, and Fire Lingyuan flapped its wings, and the fire feathers poured down from the sky like a heavy rain, shrouding the Deep Sea Demon Shark.
The pair of cyan wings behind Chu Feng stretched out in a semicircle, and feathers condensed by wind were shot out like arrows. However, the wind feathers, which could easily penetrate steel, were bounced away by the blue soul power the moment they touched the demon shark's scales, and failed to cause actual damage.
Similarly, Ye Lingyuan's blow also failed to hurt the Deep Sea Demon Shark.
Having personally experienced the two weak attacks, the Deep Sea Demon Shark already knew how to hunt these two prey.
No need to defend, you can launch an offensive as much as you like.
‘The protection is good. ’
Chu Feng's expression remained unchanged, and his left leg bone soul skill 'Red Demon's Flame' suddenly erupted.
A ball of dark red flames rose from under his feet. As the devil's soul power continued to be poured into it, the flames of the red devil expanded and spread at a speed visible to the naked eye. In the blink of an eye, half of the body of the devil shark, which was too lazy to dodge, was wrapped in it.
The flame was like gangrene attached to the bone, clinging to the blue scales, making a "sizzling" sound of corrosion. The demon shark let out a roar of pain, twisted its body wildly, and tried to get rid of the flame, but the flame grew stronger and stronger. Not only was it not extinguished by the sea water, but the soul power in its body was ignited and turned into fuel to maintain the burning.
The next moment, Chu Feng's figure flickered, and two clones that looked the same as him, but were burning with the flames of the red demon, split out of his body.
As soon as the clone took shape, it pounced on the demon shark from left to right. The left clone stuck to the demon shark in a posture that seemed to self-destruct, igniting even more intense red demon flames. The clone on the right turned into a red afterimage, got into the demon shark's mouth when it roared, rushed into the demon shark's body, and burned its internal organs from the inside.
Seeing the familiar dark red flame, Ye Lingyuan felt a sense of panic in her heart, thinking of her previous experience of besieging the three-headed Red Demon Mastiff.
She had personally experienced the power of this special flame. As long as she could not get rid of it in time, even a titled Douluo would be burned alive.
‘What a powerful soul bone skill. ’
Ye Lingyuan was amazed and couldn't help but feel a little envious.
Things are going in an unexpected direction.
Originally, she thought she would see a level 30 quasi-soul master using all his skills to kill a hundred thousand-year-old soul beast after a long and fierce battle, becoming a legend in the history of soul masters.
But look at the current situation...
As long as this deep-sea demon shark cannot extinguish the dark red flames that burn most of its body, the outcome of this hunt is already doomed.
